scenes.line1: How do you handle huge data lists?
scenes.say: Ever tried loading thousands of records at once? Let's see how smart APIs keep things fast and tidy.

scenes.label: Pagination
scenes.sub: Break results into pages using offset or cursor.
scenes.say: Pagination splits big results into pages. You can use offset and limit, or a cursor for smoother paging.
Offset is easy but can get messy if data changes. Cursor-based pagination is my pick for big or busy datasets.

scenes.title: Paging, Filtering, Sorting
scenes.say: Here's how you fetch page three of books, sorted by price. Limit and offset pick the page, sort and category filter the results.

scenes.question: Is offset always best for paging?
scenes.right: No, use cursor for large or changing data to avoid issues.
scenes.say: Don't fall for it—offset isn't always best. Cursor-based paging keeps data consistent when things change.
